Container.Name: Tracktor
Container.Overview:
Tracktor is a modern, open-source, self-hosted vehicle management platform built with SvelteKit, Tailwind CSS, and SQLite. Keep fuel logs, service history, insurance and compliance certificates, and maintenance reminders for all your vehicles in one place.
[b]Key Features:[/b] - [b]Garage Management:[/b] Multi-vehicle fleet support with individual fuel types, specs, and history. - [b]Fuel & Efficiency Tracking:[/b] Log fill-ups and monitor fuel consumption, mileage, and cost-per-distance trends. - [b]Service & Maintenance Logs:[/b] Full service history with parts, costs, and scheduled maintenance alerts. - [b]Compliance & Documents:[/b] Track insurance policies, pollution certs, and upcoming renewal expiry dates. - [b]Customizable Dashboard:[/b] Fleet-wide overview with drag-and-drop widget layout. - [b]Multi-Language:[/b] Supports 11 languages (English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, and more). - [b]Fast & Self-Contained:[/b] SQLite with Drizzle ORM, local file uploads, and zero required external services.
[b]Initial Setup:[/b] When opening the web interface for the first time at [inline]http://[IP]:[PORT:3000]/[/inline], Tracktor will automatically display the account registration form to create your admin account.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port for the Tracktor web interface (internal container port is 3000).

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Storage path for SQLite database (tracktor.db), uploaded documents, images, and log files.

Config.Name: App Secret Key
Config.Description: Secret key used to encrypt stored credentials (e.g. notification provider passwords). Generate a random 32-character hex string (e.g. run 'openssl rand -hex 32' in terminal).

Config.Name: HTTP Mode
Config.Description: Set to 'https' if running behind an SSL/TLS reverse proxy (marks session cookies as Secure), or 'http' for direct local network access.

Config.Name: Base URL Path
Config.Description: Base URL sub-path if serving behind a reverse proxy sub-folder (e.g. '/tracktor'). Leave blank if serving from root domain or subdomain.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Allowed CORS origins (comma-separated list, e.g. 'http://example.com,https://garage.domain.com' or '*' to allow all).

Config.Name: Disable Authentication
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to disable authentication entirely (not recommended).

Config.Name: Demo Mode
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to load sample demo vehicles and data.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity (error, warn, info, http, verbose, debug, silly).
